high_level_description: The image features a person standing against a brick wall. The individual is wearing a white strapless dress with a ruffled hem and a lace trim at the bottom. The dress has a fitted bodice that accentuates the figure. The person has long, dark hair styled straight and falls over one shoulder. They are accessorized with a gold watch on their left wrist, a bracelet on their right wrist, and a ring on their left hand. Their nails are painted a light color. The background consists of a dark red brick wall, which provides a contrasting backdrop to the white dress.
